input.quote: 19.2 For fifteen days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation; after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation.
input.rationale: Sections 19.1, 19.3, 19.4 and 19.5 largely meet the rule: professional/workmanlike services, conformance to documentation, no malicious code, compliance with law, a repair/re-perform/refund remedy, and a disclaimer that expressly preserves express warranties. The gap is duration: Section 19.2 limits the Deliverable conformance warranty to fifteen days and then states Vendor has no correction or refund obligation, which cuts off the Section 19.4 remedy and effectively guts the open-ended warranty in 19.1. That is far short of the preferred 12 months (software) / 90 days (services) and even the 90/30 fallback. Redline extends the period and deletes the sunset while preserving the existing non-exclusive 19.4 remedy.

proposal.summary: Extend Deliverable/software conformance warranty to 12 months and Services to 90 days; delete the clause cutting off correction and refund obligations.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the conformance warranty to twelve months for Deliverables and delivered software and ninety days for Services, and removed the sentence that ends Vendor's correction and refund obligations, which would otherwise leave the Section 19.1 warranty without any remedy after fifteen days. Our position is 12 months (software) / 90 days (services) with repair, replacement or refund; if needed we can accept 90 days for software and 30 days for Services on the same remedies.

ops.oldText: For fifteen days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation; after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation.
ops.newText: For twelve months after delivery, each Deliverable and any software delivered by Vendor will materially conform to its documentation, and for ninety days after performance the Services will conform to the warranties in Section 19.1. The remedies in Section 19.4 apply to breach of this warranty and are in addition to, and do not exclude, any other remedy available to Customer.
